'''2007 Worlds Day 1 Adam Howland DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Howland]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 1).

The sheet header writes Day 2 next to the date, but this page is bound in the Day 1 PDF (page 3 of 12).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Adam Howland]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
